title: Make one Git read decide whether a registered test check is current, at evaluate and done, instead of turn reports
outcome: A registered committed-input check counts while the named root is clean at exactly its commit when the decision is made; turn reports stay as history and stop deciding in that lane, so a correct check is not refused and a real change still is
acceptance: At evaluate and at done, for a criterion resting on a registered committed-input check, Engram reads the named root: clean under the launcher's committed-input rule and HEAD exactly the check's commit means current; anything else refuses with a plain instruction. Absent or unreachable refuses, naming why

All decision sites in the registered Git lane call one function, so evaluation and done cannot disagree, and accounted turn reports, assumed or measured, no longer refuse there; the legacy flow and every non-currency check (producer, criterion, platform, root, fence, a newer failed run) stay as they are

Real-host rows pass against the built Engram: the four traced no-edit refusals accepted and done; a real edit, a new commit, an older check and a dirty root refused at both evaluate and done, also with evaluations off; an edit reverted before the decision accepted
Engram's launcher selects commit input by default when the tree is clean and a plain run when dirty, while an explicit --input commit keeps refusing a dirty tree, matching TermAl's selection

No existing evaluation, verification, obligation resolution or seal is rewritten or reinterpreted. New evaluations and Satisfied obligation resolutions may carry an optional internally minted registered-input decision proof so doctor, seal reconstruction and import validate their immutable provenance without fresh Git or the old currency floors; absent proofs preserve the original validator. No DDL or schema-marker change is made; input protocol stays unchanged and canonical import preserves both shapes. Old-reader behavior and all-live-store readiness are explicitly classified before FULL; a required migration or different_build_schema is escalated before landing.

completion.summary: Landed and installed the shared live Git currency decision: registered committed checks count at evaluate and done only while the named root is clean at exactly their commit; ordinary reports remain history. The launcher selects clean commit input automatically and historical records retain their meaning.
